description: Snowflake folds an UNQUOTED identifier to UPPERCASE and preserves a double-quoted one. Frostlake resolves names case-insensitively, but the canonical (stored/displayed) name must fold so INFORMATION_SCHEMA, SHOW output and result-set column labels match Snowflake: lowercase-written schema/table/column names report upper-case in INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS, select-list labels fold, quoted identifiers preserve case, and the idempotent-migration idiom (guard an ADD COLUMN with an upper-case INFORMATION_SCHEMA existence check inside a scripting block) is a no-op when the column exists. Runs in its own database (test/app) created and dropped per test. Converted 1:1 from features/IdentifierCaseFoldingTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE app.cfg (col_a VARCHAR, note VARCHAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'APP' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CFG' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'NOTE'
SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'Q'
CREATE TABLE app.cfg (col_a VARCHAR, note VARCHAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CFG'
